summary: The retained RC6 evidence has useful identical-framing stage panels and stratified tracking examples, but it does not validate the reviewed candidate. It was generated from the materially different 6f9e73b pipeline, before current profile-bimodality merge detection and branch-topology splitting were introduced. Those changes directly affect masks, instance boundaries, centerlines, counts, and downstream track identities. No commit-bound visual evidence demonstrates their behavior, so acceptance is blocked.

evidence: Direct inspection of audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/KJ-01_z005_stages.png, KJ-01_z035_stages.png, KJ-01_z060_stages.png, WT-01_z005_stages.png, WT-01_z035_stages.png, and WT-01_z060_stages.png confirmed that each artifact shows raw image, foreground probability, core probability, filled mask, instance boundaries, measured centerlines, and final overlay at matching framing.
The six panels explicitly state that all stages use the same ROI crop and identical pixel framing.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/end_to_end/end_to_end_visual_evidence_manifest.json:14-63 identifies the six stage artifacts included in the retained end-to-end bundle.

Direct inspection of audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png and WT-01_stratified_tracking.png found an explicit legend: cyan denotes U-Net support, white denotes neighboring boundaries, and track color denotes the target mask, boundary, and centerline.
Both tracking figures provide an unobscured raw-data panel before annotated planes, permitting comparison when colored masks and boundaries cover raw pixels.
The stage composites retain separate unoverlaid boundary and centerline panels, so the thicker colored final overlay does not replace the measurement-geometry view.
The RC6 full-frame panels permit inspection of gross coverage and leakage, and no stage panel or label was visibly cropped during direct inspection.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:33,59,85,111,137,163 reports clear-multi-object-merge counts for the six displayed planes.

However, the panels contain no adjudicated missed-nucleus, false-split, boundary-leakage, accepted-split, or rejected-split examples for the current merge/split implementation at sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3242-3499.

Direct inspection of audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png and WT-01_stratified_tracking.png found that target colors remain fixed within each example row and occur only on the planes identified as containing the target.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json:23-47 records displayed and observed Z indices and confirms the KJ faint crop does not touch the source edge; the same structure is recorded for every example through line 569.
The tracking panels label each observed target with its plane-specific instance number while retaining the same row-level target color, making identity changes inspectable.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json:21-289 identifies KJ examples for faint, bright, short, long, wide, curved, touching, and irregular categories with deterministic selection rationales.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json:302-571 identifies the same eight categories for WT.
Direct inspection confirmed that all sixteen category rows are present and readable in the two tracking figures.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:3 binds stage evidence to commit 6f9e73b170db121460ab82f28542d1ed1e8f96bb, not reviewed commit 681a5f341709262d6ed2d473846d6432f7b7a03f.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json:3-5 likewise binds tracking evidence to 6f9e73b and pipeline blob SHA-256 1f56404b2bd683065bb229e3aa5b3579fbf3470d58563967c9db0efc12f572a1.

Commands `git rev-parse 6f9e73b:sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py` and `git rev-parse HEAD:sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py` returned different Git blobs, 7899ff084af897ac96ca646fe83520271b14e7a9 and 072ced57be6d1768bf8d1e5ba9c83b142bd225ff.
`git log --oneline 6f9e73b..HEAD -- sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py` reports later commits 64a2012, which changes objective merge flagging, and 5690569, which changes objective instance splitting.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3242-3279 implements merge evidence including profile bimodality.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3301 defines branch-topology watershed markers, and lines 3479-3499 record branch-topology splits and branch-node evidence.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:4414 applies profile-derived merge evidence in the current measurement path.

No artifact manifest found under the claim's implementation evidence is bound to reviewed commit 681a5f341709262d6ed2d473846d6432f7b7a03f and shows these current accepted or rejected merge/split cases.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json:3-11 states that tracking was generated at 6f9e73b from frozen 2D detections and that U-Net inference was not rerun.

Because current merge and split logic can change the number, geometry, and identities of 2D instances, replaying older detections cannot visually establish downstream identity continuity for the reviewed candidate.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/end_to_end/end_to_end_visual_evidence_manifest.json:3 binds the combined visual bundle to the same older generation commit.
The retained evidence includes six object-level stage composites and two plane-by-plane stratified tracking figures, not only aggregate charts.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/end_to_end/end_to_end_visual_evidence_manifest.json:14-63 enumerates the object-level stage and tracking artifacts.

findings.title: Visual evidence predates geometry-changing merge and split logic
findings.impact: The reviewed candidate can create different instance boundaries, centerlines, detection counts, and track inputs than the version depicted in the retained images. Consequently, current false splits, unresolved merges, boundary changes, and downstream identity errors cannot be assessed.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:3 records generation commit 6f9e73b.
The compared Git blobs for sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py differ between 6f9e73b and reviewed commit 681a5f3.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3242-3301 contains current profile-bimodality and branch-topology logic.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3479-3499 records current branch-topology splitting evidence.
`git log 6f9e73b..HEAD -- sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py` identifies merge and splitting changes in commits 64a2012 and 5690569.
findings.recommendation: Generate a focused visual bundle from reviewed commit 681a5f3 showing raw image, both probability heads, parent filled mask, split markers, resulting instance boundaries, centerlines, and final overlay for branch-driven, profile-bimodal, touching, accepted-split, rejected-split, and false-split-challenge cases.

findings.title: Tracking panels replay obsolete 2D detections
findings.impact: Even though identities are visually consistent in the retained RC6 examples, they cannot establish identity continuity for current segmentation outputs because merge/split changes alter the detections supplied to tracking.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json:3 binds the replay to 6f9e73b.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json:11 explicitly says U-Net inference was not rerun.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json:3-5 binds displayed tracking evidence to the older pipeline.
Current branch-topology splitting is implemented at sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3301-3499.
findings.recommendation: After generating detections with the reviewed implementation, provide focused consecutive-plane panels showing stable identity through touching/separation events, one-plane gaps, accepted splits, and rejected joins.

findings.title: Current failure modes lack adjudicated visual examples
findings.impact: Full-field overview panels alone cannot establish whether subtle missed nuclei, leakage, false splitting, or under-separation are genuine errors, especially after the new merge logic.
evidence: The six RC6 stage artifacts show overview fields but contain no expected-outcome annotations for individual missed, merged, split, or leaking cases.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:33-163 reports counts but no per-object adjudication.
No current-commit visual manifest identifies accepted and rejected split proposals from sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3347-3499.
findings.recommendation: Include enlarged, unobscured raw crops alongside thin-boundary overlays and record expected versus observed disposition for each adversarial case. Include clear successes and known failures rather than only representative overview fields.

limitations: No full image stack or expensive inference was run, as instructed.
Inspection used retained repository artifacts, manifests, Git identity comparisons, and current source; it did not treat earlier reviewers' verdicts as evidence.
The external raw Leica files referenced by manifests were not independently reopened, so source-to-render pixel identity was not re-established.
The RC6 panels support conclusions only about the older pipeline they depict, not the reviewed candidate.
recommended_follow_up: Regenerate only the focused affected planes and crops with reviewed commit 681a5f3; a full-stack rerun is unnecessary for closing this visual blocker.
Bind every replacement image to source hashes, checkpoint hash, profile hash, production pipeline blob, crop coordinates, Z indices, track IDs, and the reviewed commit.
Show parent masks and split evidence before and after current branch-topology and profile-bimodality decisions.
Regenerate downstream tracking panels from the resulting current 2D detections and request a superseding independent visual-evidence review.
